answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 188 Country: India Title: Do I need to do Masah on socks if I performed Wudu before wearing them? Question: I am working in Travel Agency in Mumbai as an Accountant.Alhamdulliah we have good practice of praying 3 times in the office premises by the grace of Almighty Allah.As masjid is far away from our office we only go for Jumma prayers and other prayers we pray in office with jamaat. My question is , I have my colleague in our office he often object me that whenever I do waju and after performing salaat I wear shocks and in that same waju I perform the next prayer also, but he says that if i am not doing waju i have to do maasa on shocks. Please guide me in the light of quran and hadith so I can correct myself. Thanks and regards! Answer ID: 188 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 554=361/H) If you offer salah after doing wuzu , and then wear the socks before the wuzu breaks, and there happens no other thing that nullifies the wuzu and you perform the next prayer with the same wuzu , then your prayer shall definitely be valid. Neither there is a need to do a fresh wuzu nor masah on socks. In short, the objection of your friend is not right. Yes, if there is any other doubt then you should write it clearly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
